newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury 2-yr note yld seen at 5.87 pct at sale.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury 2-yr note yld seen at 5.87 pct at sale.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's auction of $18.25 billion in two-year notes on Wednesday is expected to produce a yield between 5.8625 and 5.8725 percent, dealers said.

Demand for the securities appears to be firm, bolstered mainly by foreign investors. The auction's bid-to-cover ratio is expected to stay between 2.48 and 2.50. Non-competitive bids are not expected to exceed $1.0 billion, dealers said.
At 1220 EST/1720 GMT, the two-year notes were quoted at 5.865 percent in when-issued trade.
The bidding deadline for the notes is 1300 EST/1800 GMT and results are expected around 1345 EST/1845 GMT.
